title: Indian Airforce Agniveer Vayu Intake 01/2027 Result – Out
intro: Short Information : Join Indian Airforce has released the result for the post of Airforce Agniveers Vayu Intake 01/2027 on its official website. The application process for Airforce Airforce Agniveers Vayu Intake 01/2027 Online Form was carried out from 12 January 2026 to 08 February 2026. The online examination was conducted from 30 , 31 March 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their Airforce Airforce Agniveers Vayu Intake 01/2027 Result from the link provided below.
importantDates: Admit Card : 24-48 Hours Before the Exam Date
applicationFee: General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 550/- (+18% GST Extra)
